source_review.finding: The source matches the frozen causal recipe: FP32 raw i1 lag and i0-16 differences are standardized and clipped before updates; B updates through row 98 inclusive; the base retains the parent 211-wide normalization; the 208 added features are clipped to 8; the head returns parent plus 0.1 times its residual.
source_review.limitation: Source review only; no fit, output prediction, or quality grade was inspected.

findings.finding: The current recipe remains deferred with zero admitted fits, and the full execution/admission gate has not passed.
findings.consequence: The grader rejects this recipe before opening candidate artifacts or the official target cache. Code, cache profiles, and partial endpoints cannot be reported as a completed screen.

findings.finding: Fold, seed, parent checkpoint, propensity ancestry, and selected fit components vary together between F0/1001 and F1/1002.
findings.consequence: Keep all 26 contrasts fold-local; do not estimate a seed effect or attribute cross-fold differences to the head arm.

findings.finding: Selected-parent fit predictions are in-sample; evaluation parent predictions are separate full-fold endpoints, and both folds are exposed development evidence.
findings.consequence: Never grade fit-scope parent outputs as endpoints. Component intervals are conditional on fixed endpoints, not training-seed variance, a fresh holdout, or public transfer.

findings.finding: Prediction rows can be misaligned if a permissive superset is accepted or NPY trailing bytes are ignored.
findings.consequence: Require exact ordered source-qualified refs, complete fold coverage, little-endian FP32 NPY header/payload coverage, and matching checkpoint, provenance, parent-cache, normalizer, source, and prediction hashes before loading targets.

findings.finding: The planned grader validates exported prediction bytes against their sidecars and provenance but does not independently rerun all candidate checkpoints.
findings.consequence: Interpret graded predictions as the producer's fixed exported endpoints; no independent inference parity claim is made.

planned_grade.primary_intervals: Overall global_wp_clip2_v1 only, paired by dependency component within each fold.
planned_grade.conditional_points: Both target correlations and four fixed position-bin scores for every contrast.
planned_grade.resampling_scope: Fixed-endpoint component resampling; no seed/fold pooling or best-lag significance claim.
planned_grade.multiplicity: No multiplicity adjustment; intervals are descriptive fixed-panel uncertainty summaries.

limitations: Current-recipe and source review only. No candidate predictions, official targets, or quality scores were read.
